tool_input.command:
cd "$(pwd)"
hops --quiet fg create recs81f771 --version 1 --primary-key rec_id --online \
  --features "rec_id:string,user_id:string,rank:int,item_id:string" \
  --description "top-5 recommendations per user" 2>&1 | tail -6
tool_input.description: Create online recs feature group

tool_input.command:
cd "$(pwd)"
mkdir -p .tmp
hops --quiet --json --no-verify sql --catalog delta --schema mlpab0ee9be_featurestore --limit 0 "
WITH scored AS (
  SELECT u.user_id AS user_id, i.item_id AS item_id,
    (u.e1*i.e1 + u.e2*i.e2 + u.e3*i.e3 + u.e4*i.e4 + u.e5*i.e5 + u.e6*i.e6 + u.e7*i.e7 + u.e8*i.e8) AS rel
  FROM user_emb_81f771_1 u
  CROSS JOIN item_emb_81f771_1 i
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inter_81f771_1 x WHERE x.user_id = u.user_id AND x.item_id = i.item_id)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, item_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY rel DESC, item_id ASC) AS rank
  FROM scored
)
SELECT user_id || '#' || CAST(rank AS VARCHAR) AS rec_id, user_id, rank, item_id
FROM ranked WHERE rank <= 5 ORDER BY user_id, rank
" > .tmp/recs_out.txt 2>.tmp/recs_err.txt
tail -3 .tmp/recs_err.txt
echo "=== head of result ==="
head -40 .tmp/recs_out.txt
tool_input.description: Compute top-5 recommendations via Trino

tool_input.command:
cd "$(pwd)"
echo "rec_id count:"; grep -c '"rec_id"' .tmp/recs_out.txt
echo "first line:"; head -1 .tmp/recs_out.txt
echo "last line:"; tail -1 .tmp/recs_out.txt
echo "distinct users:"; grep -o '"user_id": "U[0-9]*"' .tmp/recs_out.txt | sort -u | wc -l
tool_input.description: Validate JSON result completeness

tool_input.command:

cp .tmp/recs_out.txt .tmp/recs.json
hops --quiet fg insert recs81f771 --version 1 --file .tmp/recs.json 2>&1 | tail -8
tool_input.description: Insert recommendations into recs81f771
